identity: A structural support column, octagonal in plan with a wider base ring, about 0.7 m across. It stands on the concourse centre-line on purpose: the hall is built around it and traffic parts around it.
units: absolute local units (31 = player height), top-down, origin at the column axis.

silhouette.note: base ring; flat - a crescent on a small top-down octagon reads as a broken ring
